name: Off-Highway Motorcycle
description: An electric motorcycle built for off-highway use, such as an electric dirt bike, ridden under the off-highway category of each classification naming this group. A vehicle carries this group's id in place of each classification in it.
restrictions: Built by its manufacturer for off-highway use, not for the road
No limit on motor power or speed
Kept off public roads except where its jurisdiction allows it
Each classification naming this group holds its own jurisdiction's license, registration, insurance, helmet and riding rules
